comment_threads_anchor_matches_kind.name: comment_threads_anchor_matches_kind
comment_threads_anchor_matches_kind.value:
("comment_threads"."anchor_kind" = 'storyboard_shot') = ("comment_threads"."anchor_shot_id" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("comment_threads"."anchor_kind" <> 'storyboard_shot') = ("comment_threads"."anchor_node_id" IS NOT NULL)

beats_minutes_not_negative.name: beats_minutes_not_negative
beats_minutes_not_negative.value: ("beats"."duration_minutes" IS NULL OR "beats"."duration_minutes" >= 0) AND ("beats"."placed_at_minute" IS NULL OR "beats"."placed_at_minute" >= 0)

credit_ledger_delta_matches_kind.name: credit_ledger_delta_matches_kind
credit_ledger_delta_matches_kind.value:
(
        ("credit_ledger"."kind" IN ('reserve', 'spend', 'expire') AND "credit_ledger"."delta" < 0)
        OR ("credit_ledger"."kind" IN ('grant', 'purchase', 'release', 'refund') AND "credit_ledger"."delta" > 0)
        OR ("credit_ledger"."kind" = 'adjust' AND "credit_ledger"."delta" <> 0)
      )
